action_instruction: Checking whether the task card priority badge matches the task priority value
intent: whether the task card's priority badge text matches the task card's explicit priority value

action_params.condition: the task card's stored priority value equals the stated promise: A task card with an explicit High or Low priority shows that same priority value on its badge
action_params.query: whether the task card's priority badge text matches the task card's explicit priority value
action_params.code_js: (() => { const badge = el(9).querySelector('.priority-badge'); return !!badge && badge.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === (Array.from(badge.classList).find(c => c.startsWith('priority-') && c !== 'priority-badge') || '').replace('priority-',''); })()

assertion_tree.description: the task card's stored priority value equals the stated promise: A task card with an explicit High or Low priority shows that same priority value on its badge

sub_results.description: the task card's stored priority value equals the stated promise: A task card with an explicit High or Low priority shows that same priority value on its badge

assertion_tree.verification: the current page shows that a task card with an explicit High or Low priority has a badge displaying that same priority value
